privacy.title: Privacy & data
privacy.consentHelp: Allow EasyTutor to process your learning data.
privacy.confirmWithdrawMessage: Withdrawal stops future processing. Existing records remain until you delete your data.
privacy.exportHelp: Download a JSON copy of your learning data.
privacy.exportFailed: Export failed — no file was downloaded
privacy.deleteHelp: Removes your learner-owned data. Append-only audit history is retained for integrity.
privacy.confirmDeleteMessage: This cannot be undone. Mutable learner data will be erased; append-only audit records are retained.
privacy.deleteFailed: Deletion incomplete (audit {{auditId}}) — local data was kept
